title: Pearl Orbit
description: A B-minor phrase becomes two unequal circles: five-note arpeggios underneath a four-note singing pulse. A quiet chordal window interrupts the orbit, which returns in a brighter register and finally unwinds into an open A-major ninth.
technical_note: Practise each two-beat quintuplet against four even eighths, retaining the melody across their different points of contact. The central chords release that coordination before the current returns. The final bars broaden without accelerating the arpeggios.

performance.note: The quintuplets stay light and even, against the broader upper phrase. Allow the harmonic detour to darken the colour before the higher return.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
